conventions: Use APP.THREE instead of global THREE inside @ability and procedural blocks.
Always combine AI creativity with repository instructions (interaction.txt, physics.txt, bot.txt, models.txt).
Set instancedMesh.userData.skipMatrixShader = true on InstancedMesh objects.
Only add @pin if a user explicitly asks to pin a button to the toolbar; keep the toolbar clean and basic.
Support live HTML/DOM/CSS edits when requested from the prompt tape or AI Studio.
learnedRules: Always make sure new pen objects are initialized with active drawing capabilities.
